text:
sam.ops: :rotating_light: Seeing a huge retry flood from the notify-consumer, multiple pages firing and then some alerts suppressed. Customers reporting duplicate pages. Anyone seeing this?
priya.sre: I'm seeing large spikes in webhook retries in the consumer logs, looks like idempotency keys not being set on retry path.
jake.eng: Confirmed. The consumer crashed and retry loop replayed ~200 webhooks in a short window, incident-bot attempted to resend and created duplicates.
luis.platform: Oof. Is the consumer backing off? What's the replay pattern?
priya.sre: Consumer did exponential backoff but a recent deploy changed retry logic to requeue immediately on 502. That bypassed the scheduled backoff.
oncall: Received 5 pages in <3 minutes, P1 on our side. I'm muting the channel until triage is set.
incident-bot: Automated: triggered page escalation for alert_id=alc-42, retry_count=1, route=oncall -> paged. (This is an automated message)
sam.ops: Manual mitigation: pausing notify-consumer queue in prod, putting a temporary filter to drop retry duplicates. Can someone confirm queue paused?
jake.eng: I've paused the consumer shard for region-us-east-1 and added a quick toggle to block re-enqueues. Will push a narrow hotfix to restore exponential backoff.
priya.sre: Adding note for playbook: we should prefer server-side idempotency header X-Inc-Id and have retry use the same id. Right now retry path regenerates new id.
luis.platform: Patch pushed to revert the requeue behavior, rolling out to 2 pods now. Deploy-bot: starting rollout 2024-05-12T17:13Z.
deploy-bot: rollout: notify-consumer v3.4.2 -> v3.4.1-retry-fix started (canary 1/3)
jake.eng: Canary looks good, no replay in logs for canary instance. Promoting.
priya.sre: Oncall, can you validate that page noise has stopped?
oncall: Confirmed - noise decreased, only the original alert remains. No new duplicates in last 10m. Thanks.
sam.ops: Customer impact estimate: ~120 duplicate pages sent across 18 customers, some received delayed acknowledgements. Filing customer outreach doc.
luis.platform: Follow-up action items: 1) add idempotency header enforcement on consumer 2) add dedupe in incident-bot 3) improve circuit breaker so retries don't bypass backoff 4) postmortem owner assignment.
priya.sre: I'll own the postmortem. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow. Adding runbook step to mute channel when >3 duplicates detected.
jake.eng: Quick repro for QA (share with team):
```bash
# simulate retry flood
curl -X POST https://notify.example/internal/webhook \n  -H "X-Inc-Id: test-dup-123" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"alert":"test","retries":0}'
# then trigger retry path to ensure X-Inc-Id preserved
```
sam.ops: Good. I'll coordinate customer comms. Thanks @priya.sre @jake.eng @luis.platform for fast rollback. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Automated: incidents/1734567890 updated, status=mitigated, actions_taken=[consumer_paused, rollback_deployed]
